items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Joins Illumina’s Billion Cell Atlas For AI Drug Discovery
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) has joined Illumina's Billion Cell Atlas alliance as a foundational participant. The alliance is building what is described as the world's largest genome-wide genetic perturbation dataset. The Billion Cell Atlas is sequencing hundreds of millions of cells to map disease mechanisms and find new drug targets.
